methods.label: Check the rotation properties and overlapping choices
methods.explanation:
The figures before and after a rotation are congruent, so corresponding line segments are equal in length and corresponding angles are equal.

This makes A true. Equal corresponding lengths are also proportional with common ratio \(1\): if corresponding segment lengths are \(\ell>0\) and \(\ell'\), then \(\ell'=\ell\), so \(\ell'/\ell=1\). Thus B is true as well. C is not a general rotation property; for example, a \(60^\circ\) angle remains \(60^\circ\), and these two angles are not supplementary. Therefore A and B both hold, so the keyed A is not the unique correct choice.
